hooks.statusMessage: cloud sandbox setup (uv sync + local Postgres)

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.css|*.js|*.json|*.jsonc) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$(dirname "$f")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 0; if ! biome --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'biome not installed (mise install); lint skipped' >&2; exit 0; fi; out=$(biome lint --error-on-warnings --no-errors-on-unmatched --colors=off "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }

jq -e '.stop_hook_active' >/dev/null && exit 0; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && uv run ruff format --quiet src tests; uv run pyrefly check src tests scripts --summary=none --output-format=min-text >&2 || exit 2; if biome --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then biome format --write >/dev/null 2>&1; biome lint --error-on-warnings --colors=off >&2 || exit 2; else echo 'biome not installed (mise install); check skipped' >&2; fi
hooks.statusMessage: ruff format + pyrefly type check + biome format + lint
